description: Advisory checks for the exact documented DSS trackapi2 pixel template and visitor-ID prose. Management authentication, entity requirements, dsa-eu and SSP collectors are excluded.

params.name: pid
params.description: The published pixel template includes an opaque Pixel ID. The example does not establish a 24-hex or numeric grammar.

params.name: txid
params.description: The pixel prose describes a visitor ID of exactly 20 characters from lowercase 0-9a-f.

params.name: evt
params.description: The published pixel template includes an event name. No event vocabulary or numeric prefix is required.

params.name: cnt
params.description: The documented pixel template leaves cnt empty. Requiredness, grammar and receiver meaning are not established.
